selected_evidence.requirement: Topology setup: node2 on lan-a, node3 on lan-b, node1 routing between them
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered unconfigured lan-a/lan-b interfaces, assigned VyOS eth1/eth2 addresses and node2/node3 static IPs, confirmed correct LAN mapping via ping

selected_evidence.requirement: Routing asymmetry fixed so node2<->node3 traffic actually transits node1
selected_evidence.summary: Found competing default routes causing wrong-path traffic; added explicit static routes on node2/node3 via node1; confirmed with TTL-decremented ping showing traffic transits the router

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 can reach node3 on TCP 5432
selected_evidence.summary: Opened node3 firewalld for 5432 from lan-a, applied VyOS forward-filter accept rule for tcp/5432 eth1->eth2, confirmed successful connection end to end

selected_evidence.requirement: All other traffic between lan-a and lan-b is rejected, both directions
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed other TCP port (8080) blocked, ICMP blocked lan-a->lan-b, and TCP/5432 + ICMP blocked in reverse direction lan-b->lan-a, matching VyOS default-drop forward filter

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id/firewall counters, issued native VyOS reboot, polled until back, boot_id changed (ebd78841->d5feb03c), confirmed interfaces/firewall config persisted and policy still enforced

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id/routes, issued systemctl reboot, polled until back, boot_id changed (8f258838->4e26764f), confirmed static route and firewall policy still enforced (5432 allowed, 8080 blocked)

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id/route/listener, issued systemctl reboot, polled until back, boot_id changed (0581c914->bbab88ba), confirmed static route and firewalld rich rule persisted, restarted test listener, and re-verified end-to-end 5432-allow/ICMP-block policy
